learning_objective: 🎯 We will observe the unique shapes of musical instruments and draw the magic of music!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at a drum, it is a big cylinder! A flute is a long thin rectangle with little circles. Every instrument has a special shape that makes a unique sound.
Instruments in India are decorated beautifully. We can add zig-zag patterns on our drums and colorful tassels on our guitars!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Design a Magic Drum
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big round Dholak. Use your favorite crayons to cover it in beautiful stars, stripes, and bright colors!

quick_recap: ⭐ Musical instruments have basic shapes like cylinders and rectangles.
⭐ We can make our instruments look beautiful with colorful patterns.
⭐ Drawing musical notes around an instrument makes it look like it is playing!
